question: LIVE EXERCISE: build something small (a simple function or short script) using an AI coding assistant of their choice, screen-shared, thinking out loud.
rubric_guide:
Strong: writes a clear, specific initial instruction, not vague "build me X"; reviews generated code before accepting, doesn't click through blindly; catches at least one real issue in the output; iterates with a good follow-up refinement.
Weak: accepts everything without reading it, or can't get anywhere without heavy prompting help.
